Policy_Rule: Orders may be cancelled before the order enters packed status; after packing, cancellation becomes a return request.
Address or item changes are allowed only before packing and only after identity verification.
For failed checkout, preserve the cart and retry only after confirming no completed payment exists.
Finance verifies payment status using the transaction reference; agents must not request full card numbers or CVVs.
Verified duplicate captures are refunded to the original payment method within 5 business days.
Invoices are issued against completed orders; invoice corrections require the order ID and billing details.
Standard delivery target is 3-5 business days; delays beyond 2 business days trigger logistics review.
Address correction is permitted before courier handoff; after handoff, Logistics must contact the courier.
Customer should provide parcel/product photos within 7 days; Quality decides replacement, return or rejection.
A parcel marked delivered but not received requires delivery verification before replacement/refund.
Eligible unopened or defective items may be returned within 14 calendar days unless excluded by category rules.
Approved refunds are initiated within 5 business days; bank posting time may take additional time.
Refund amount disputes require order, refund reference and payment record comparison.
Password reset requires verified email/OTP; agents must not disclose existing passwords.
Suspected takeover requires session revocation, credential reset and security review.
Defects reported within the return window receive quality assessment and, where eligible, replacement or refund.
Promotions apply only when eligibility, dates and qualifying products/thresholds are satisfied.
Repeatable site/app failures are logged with steps, timestamp and device/browser details when available.
Agents must remain professional; threats, abuse or harassment are documented and escalated without retaliation.
Privacy requests and suspected personal-data exposure are routed to Privacy & Compliance; sensitive data is minimized.
Orders above PKR 150,000 require enhanced verification before exceptional refunds or replacements.
Mandatory escalation conditions override normal handling where safety, security, legal, privacy, repeated failure or high-value exposure is involved.
